name: German Personalausweis
description: German ID card (Personalausweis) or passport copy. Detects the document number (Ausweisnummer), the access number (CAN / Zugangsnummer), Steuer-ID, the machine-readable zone (MRZ), date of birth and German addresses, plus names. Pair with manual redaction to black out the photo and signature.

patterns.name: Ausweisnummer
patterns.description: German ID card or passport document number: 9-10 letters and digits, matched with its label (Ausweisnummer, Dokumentennummer, Serien-Nr., Pass-Nr.).

patterns.name: CAN
patterns.description: Card Access Number: 6 digits, matched with its label (CAN, Zugangsnummer).

patterns.name: MRZ
patterns.description: Machine-readable zone lines: the '<' filler runs on ID cards and passports.

patterns.name: Date
patterns.description: Date of birth or expiry, DD.MM.YYYY.
